name: BADEUCY
description: Badeucy is a sophisticated split-pot poker variant that blends the mechanics of Badugi with Deuce-to-Seven Triple Draw. In this high-stakes favorite, players aim to build two specific low hands: a 4-card 'Badugi' (four different suits and ranks) and a 5-card Deuce-to-Seven low. Unlike its sister game Badacey, Aces in Badeucy are always high and detrimental, making the 2-3-4-5-7 'Wheel' the ultimate goal.

content.text: Badeucy is a sophisticated split-pot poker variant that blends the mechanics of Badugi with Deuce-to-Seven Triple Draw. In this high-stakes favorite, players aim to build two specific low hands: a 4-card 'Badugi' (four different suits and ranks) and a 5-card Deuce-to-Seven low. Unlike its sister game Badacey, Aces in Badeucy are always high and detrimental, making the 2-3-4-5-7 'Wheel' the ultimate goal.

Part of the modern 'Mixed Game' evolution in high-stakes poker rooms. It was popularized by players who enjoyed the complexity of Deuce-to-Seven Lowball and wanted to add a Badugi component back when Badugi was the newest trend in the mid-2000s.

Two to six players. All players make an ante bet; the dealer gives each player five cards face down, then a round of betting and three draw-and-bet cycles before the final betting and split-pot showdown.
Poker chips, Dealer button, Small/Big Blind markers.
5 cards face down to each player. 3 draw phases follow.

items.text: Badacey: The variant where Aces are low and straights/flushes are ignored.
